# Grey's x E&F+hotfix compatch -- restore E&F's company-HQ employment on top of USU's HQ bodies
# Generated by tools/regen_greys_ef.py on 2026-08-27. Do not hand-edit: the next
# run overwrites this file. Change the generator instead.
#
# Load order: TGR -> ... -> E&F -> E&F Hotfix -> ... -> Grey's pack -> THIS.
# Why this file exists: vanilla employs 50 pops per HQ level; E&F cuts that to ~10 with a REPLACE: that names building_modifiers and nothing else; USU rebalances the same block back to 50 and loads last, so E&F's cut disappears. Decision 27.08.2026: E&F's scale wins, USU's structure (its shopkeeper split, its share math, its gates) stays. TGR's state_modifiers block is carried in the same body on purpose -- USU never names it, so whether it survives today depends on the unresolved REPLACE-semantics question in the rules; naming it here is correct under both readings.

# 14 methods, all three layers in one body:
#   structure, textures, gates, employment split  -- grey_usu (loads last)
#   building_modifiers (E&F's HQ employment cut)  -- E&F, verbatim
#   state_modifiers (trade capacity, tax capacity) -- TGR, verbatim

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:pm_company_headquarter_privately_owned = {
	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/production_method_icons/privately_owned.dds"
	is_hidden_when_unavailable = yes
	
	unlocking_company_categories = {
		capitalist_owned
	}

	disallowing_laws = {
		law_command_economy
		law_cooperative_ownership
	}

		level_scaled = {
			building_employment_capitalists_add = 3
			building_employment_shopkeepers_add = 3.5
			building_employment_clerks_add = 3.5
		}
		unscaled = {
			building_capitalists_shares_add = 10
			building_shopkeepers_shares_add = 1
		}
	}

	# TGR's layer, carried so a full body cannot drop it:
	state_modifiers = {
		level_scaled = {				
			state_weekly_trades_add = 0.5
			state_trade_capacity_add = 1	
			state_tax_capacity_add = 0.25
		}
	}
}
